44009.subject: Technical Drawing
44009.question_text: Using the appropriate drawing instruments, construct a perpendicular bisector of a line segment AB = 80 mm. Label all construction lines and points clearly.
44009.explanation:
1. Draw line segment AB = 80 mm.
2. With A as center and radius greater than half of AB, draw arcs above and below the line.
3. With B as center and the same radius, draw arcs intersecting the previous arcs at points C and D.
4. Join C and D to form the perpendicular bisector.
5. The intersection of CD and AB is the midpoint M.

44010.subject: Technical Drawing
44010.question_text: Construct a regular hexagon with a side length of 30 mm using the circumscribed circle method. Show all construction lines and label the vertices as A, B, C, D, E, F.
44010.explanation:
1. Draw a circle with radius = 30 mm.
2. Mark a point A on the circumference.
3. Using the same radius, step off points B, C, D, E, F around the circle.
4. Join the points to form the hexagon.
5. Ensure all sides are equal and angles are 120°.

44011.subject: Technical Drawing
44011.question_text: Given the isometric view of a block below (assume dimensions: 50 mm × 30 mm × 20 mm), draw the front, top, and right-side orthographic views using first-angle projection. Include all hidden details.
44011.explanation:
1. Front view: 50 mm (width) × 20 mm (height).
2. Top view: 50 mm (width) × 30 mm (depth).
3. Right-side view: 30 mm (depth) × 20 mm (height).
4. Use dashed lines for hidden edges.
5. Align views according to first-angle projection rules.

44012.subject: Technical Drawing
44012.question_text: Draw a full sectional front view of the object shown in the orthographic views below (assume a cylindrical hole of diameter 20 mm through the center). Use hatching to indicate the cut surface.
44012.explanation:
1. Identify the cutting plane (assume vertical through the center).
2. Remove the front half of the object.
3. Draw the remaining half with visible edges.
4. Hatch the cut surface at 45°.
5. Show the hole as a circle in section.

44013.subject: Technical Drawing
44013.question_text: Draw an isometric view of a cube with edges of 40 mm. Include all hidden edges as dashed lines. Label the isometric axes X, Y, Z.
44013.explanation:
1. Draw the isometric axes at 120° to each other.
2. Construct the top face as a rhombus with sides = 40 mm.
3. Project vertical edges downward (40 mm).
4. Complete the bottom face.
5. Use dashed lines for hidden edges.

44014.subject: Technical Drawing
44014.question_text: Develop the lateral surface of a right circular cone with base diameter 50 mm and slant height 60 mm. Show all construction lines and label the development.
44014.explanation:
1. Calculate the base circumference: $C = \pi d = \pi \times 50$ mm.
2. Draw a sector of radius = 60 mm and arc length = $C$.
3. Divide the sector into equal parts (e.g., 12) for accuracy.
4. Label the development as Sector AOB.

44015.subject: Technical Drawing
44015.question_text: Redraw the given orthographic views (assume dimensions: 80 mm × 50 mm × 30 mm) and apply correct dimensioning using aligned system. Include all necessary dimensions for manufacturing.
44015.explanation:
1. Dimension overall sizes (80 mm, 50 mm, 30 mm).
2. Use extension lines and dimension lines.
3. Place dimensions outside the views where possible.
4. Avoid duplicate dimensions.
5. Use aligned dimensioning for clarity.

44016.subject: Technical Drawing
44016.question_text: Construct an external tangent to two circles with diameters 40 mm and 20 mm, and centers 60 mm apart. Show all construction lines.
44016.explanation:
1. Draw the two circles with centers O₁ and O₂.
2. Draw a line connecting O₁O₂.
3. Construct a semicircle on O₁O₂.
4. From O₂, draw an arc with radius = difference of radii (10 mm) to intersect the semicircle at P.
5. Extend O₁P to meet the larger circle at T₁.
6. Draw O₂T₂ parallel to O₁T₁.
7. Join T₁T₂ for the tangent.

44017.subject: Technical Drawing
44017.question_text: Given the front and top views of an inclined surface, draw the true shape of the surface using an auxiliary view. Show all projection lines.
44017.explanation:
1. Identify the edge view of the inclined surface in the front view.
2. Draw a reference line perpendicular to the edge view.
3. Project points from the top view parallel to the reference line.
4. Transfer distances from the front view to the auxiliary plane.
5. Complete the true shape.

44018.subject: Technical Drawing
44018.question_text: Draw the line of interpenetration between a vertical cylinder (diameter 50 mm) and a horizontal cylinder (diameter 30 mm) intersecting at right angles. Show the front and top views.
44018.explanation:
1. Draw the front and top views of both cylinders.
2. Divide the horizontal cylinder into 12 equal parts in the top view.
3. Project points to the front view.
4. Locate intersection points in the front view.
5. Draw a smooth curve through the points for the line of interpenetration.
